entries.logic: Uses a 'while' loop with 'jobs -p' to monitor the number of concurrent background processes and throttle execution.
entries.rationale: Prevents system resource exhaustion (Fork Bomb) while maximizing throughput for heavy batch operations.

entries.logic: Always uses the 'wait' command after a parallel loop to ensure all background tasks are completed before the script continues or exits.
entries.rationale: Essential for SSQLM reliability to ensure no orphan processes are left behind.
